# stalemap

> stalemap tells coding agents which of a JavaScript or TypeScript project's dependencies changed after the agent's model was trained, and what changed. It gives the agent that information three ways: notes written into AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md at session start, an edit-time guard that runs the project's own `tsc` after every edit and explains errors caused by changed APIs, and an MCP tool, `search_changes`, the agent can query in its own words. It works with Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, OpenCode and any MCP client. MIT-licensed, on npm as `stalemap` (latest 0.4.0).

Key facts:

- **Problem it solves:** a model's knowledge stops at its training cutoff. When a project pins newer library versions, agents write code for the old API: `maxSteps` against AI SDK 7, `required_error` against zod 4, `middleware.ts` against Next.js 16, `next()` in mongoose 9 pre hooks.
- **How it knows what changed:**
  - For each direct dependency, it picks the version the model plausibly knew: the newest stable release at least 30 days before the cutoff.
  - It then compares that version with the installed one: type declarations (removed, renamed and moved exports, new required options), release notes, upgrade guides, and the pull requests behind terse release notes.
  - It ranks the changes by what the project's code actually imports and configures.
- **Measured result (held-out v4, blind and pre-registered):**
  - 66 tasks built from changes released July–October 2026, graded by hidden tests.
  - `claude-sonnet-5-5` passed 89% of sessions with stalemap, vs 68% with no help (+20.7 points, 95% interval [13.6, 28.3]) and 73% with a plain `tsc --noEmit` hook after each edit (+16.4 points [7.6, 26.0]).
  - `claude-sonnet-4-5` passed 64% vs 46% (+17.9) and vs 53% (+10.6).
  - All four pre-registered comparisons were wins.
- **Privacy:** package names and versions go to the npm registry and GitHub. Source code is scanned locally and never uploaded.
- **Install for Claude Code:** `/plugin marketplace add Umair/stalemap` then `/plugin install stalemap@stalemap`. Other agents: `npx stalemap setup --agent cursor|codex|opencode`. Any MCP client: `npx -y stalemap@latest mcp`.

## Install (for AI agents)

- [Install instructions for agents](https://stalemap.com/install.md): step by step, non-interactive, safe to re-run. Short version: `npx -y stalemap@latest setup --agent <claude|cursor|codex|opencode> --model <your-model-id> --yes`, then `npx -y stalemap@latest check --model <your-model-id>`
- [This site as Markdown](https://stalemap.com/index.md): also served at `https://stalemap.com/?agent=1`, and at `/` with `Accept: text/markdown`
